issues.claim: 'Right On Air Conditioning and Heating' is a Somerset (Franklin Township) HVAC contractor with a map pin inside the township.
issues.problem: Town is wrong as a base. I opened the BBB record and the company's own contact page metadata: BBB profiles the business under Kendall Park (South Brunswick) and it carries HVACR licence 19HC00549900; it advertises Somerset as a service town, not a base. No Somerset street address exists.
issues.fix: Change town to 'Kendall Park (serves Franklin Township)' and flag it out-of-area, or drop it; do not let telemarketing treat it as a township shop.

issues.claim: 'Lipari Pools' is a zone business ('Somerset County (serves Franklin Township)').
issues.problem: Its published base is 135 Lincoln Blvd, Middlesex NJ 08846, outside Franklin Township; the website itself is inconsistent (says Bridgewater, lists Middlesex). Only a service-area page touches the zone.
issues.fix: Move to an out-of-area 'serves the zone' annex or delete; do not include in the in-zone call list.

issues.claim: 'Master Attic, LLC' is a prospect for this zone because it has a Somerset attic-insulation service page.
issues.problem: Its own contact page lists 2486 Ridgeway Blvd, Manchester Township NJ 08759, roughly 50 miles away and far outside the 10-mile radius from central Milltown. It is a service-area landing page only.
issues.fix: Drop the entry from this zone; if kept, label it explicitly as an out-of-area installer with no local base.

issues.claim: The list keeps 'Somerset Garage Door Solutions' and 'Somerset Appliance Repair Men' as entries (both self-flagged as unverified).
issues.problem: These are keyword-style, single-record listings with no own site, no licence and (for the garage-door one) an address shared with an unrelated national tyre outlet. They are retained inside the main businesses array, so a fast reader will treat them as leads.
issues.fix: Remove them from the businesses array (or keep in a clearly separated quarantine file) so the call list contains only verifiable operators.

issues.claim: 'Kleaner Image Home Services' is at 9999 Kingsberry Dr, Somerset.
issues.problem: Confirmed only as a bulk-directory value (Yellow Pages); 9999 is not a plausible street number and no second source exists. The entry already warns about it, but the bogus string is still in the address field.
issues.fix: Blank the address field to 'Unknown' and keep the phone only.

issues.claim: 'Promise Pest Control' is at an unrecorded Somerset address, phone 732-247-7416.
issues.problem: Two live directories disagree: Yellow Pages gives 732-247-7416, while the Yahoo Local Somerset pest-control page I opened lists 7 Waldorf St, Somerset 08873 with (732) 249-9542. One of the two records is probably stale.
issues.fix: Resolve the address/phone (7 Waldorf St, 732-249-9542) before adding it to a dial list.

issues.claim: Roofing/contractor coverage is now complete after the revision.
issues.problem: Coverage is good but not complete: my independent searches surfaced eligible in-zone businesses that are absent, notably Adam & Sons Plumbers (698 Hamilton St #6400, 4.8-4.9 from 188-339 reviews) and Karlo & Brothers Plumbing (96 S Dover Ave).
issues.fix: Add Adam & Sons Plumbers and Karlo & Brothers Plumbing (plumbing is the thinnest covered trade relative to demand), plus the other six missing names listed in coverage.missing.

issues.claim: 'Hammer Exteriors' is at 370 Campus Dr, Somerset.
issues.problem: The address could not be re-confirmed: the company site (opened) shows the Somerset/Serving-all-NJ positioning and the 973-442-6637 number but no street address, and the BBB profile that carries 370 Campus Dr blocks fetching. Address remains single-source.
issues.fix: Confirm 370 Campus Dr on a second readable source before routing or mailing.

issues.claim: Zone/10-mile test for service-area entries (Lipari, Master Attic, New Jersey Septic Management Group, Green Sun Energy Services, S & R Pool & Spa).
issues.problem: Several entries are service-area businesses whose base is unconfirmed or known to be outside the township. Two of them (Master Attic, Lipari) are now confirmed out-of-zone on their own sites; the rest remain unconfirmed.
issues.fix: Apply one rule: only entries with a confirmed 08873/08823 (or Middlebush/East Millton) base stay in the zone file; everything else goes to a separate service-area annex.

issues.claim: Many electrician / general-contractor entries come from Cylex category pages.
issues.problem: Cylex, Yellow Pages, BBB, BuildZoom, Superpages and the Original YP all block automated fetching (403), so most of those rows can only be re-read in a real browser; street addresses were verified for 20 of them in the browser this pass, the rest could not be.
issues.fix: Treat the browser-verified rows as confirmed; re-pull any row still resting on a single blocked-directory record before outreach.
